result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. Carousel clipping and the partially visible bottom card are intentional and not reported. A few real issues remain: a typo in the search placeholder, a time badge that overlaps its image edge, and some low-contrast text.

issues.description: The search placeholder has a typo: 'Restarants' should be 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the string to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' and check localization strings for other typos.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' cards, the delivery-time pill (e.g. '15–25 min') sits at the bottom-left edge of the image and overlaps or crosses the image boundary. It looks misaligned, and its position isn't consistent with the '€0 delivery' badge on the cards below.
issues.suggestion: Inset the time pill consistently from the image edges, keep it fully inside the image, and use the same badge placement across card types.

issues.description: Secondary text is light gray on white or light backgrounds, for example the delivery fee under the card titles, the '(500+)' rating count, and the inactive nav labels. Contrast is low and may fall below WCAG AA.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive icon colors to reach at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the pizza card sits on a dark translucent circle, while the one on the ramen card has almost no visible background. The two look inconsistent, and the icon's contrast against busy images is weak.
issues.suggestion: Use the same button background style on all cards, such as a solid or semi-opaque circle, so the icon stays visible on any image.
